name: JellyLibraryAccess
description: Approve individual Jellyfin movies for restricted profiles without moving media files.
overview: Per-title library access using Jellyfin Allowed Tags, with persistent TMDb/IMDb matching.

versions.changelog: Fix baseline library discovery on Jellyfin 10.11.x.
